title: RPM Indicator
text: Display measurements for engine revolutions per minute (RPM) in percentage of RPM, {Label} sets Block label location; {Connection} sets the connect to signal and {Scale Colors} sets the ranges of color bands. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Scale Colors
params.values: Ranges of color bands 0 (default) | double | scalar

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label location Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
